info.title: ContentKit
info.description: ContentKit's HTTP API, under the prefix the host mounts contentkit.Engine.Routes at (contentkit.Routes.Prefix). Each module sits at its own sub-path (x-contentkit-modules) and is one route group. Generated from the route catalog (internal/httpapi) by `go generate ./internal/contract`; do not edit.

get.summary: A content item: its text in the viewer's language, live versions with their segments and access, groups and attributes; the body only to viewers who open a version, everyone else its description and the paywall decision. Editors see every version, every language and the moderation state.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: the language to show text in; the site's first language, then any, when it has none

patch.summary: Edits a content item's listing, access, restrictions, attributes, cover or creators. Creators, the owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) and root:content:write holders only.

delete.summary: Deletes a content item: holders of its key still read it; one never sold is erased after the retention. Creators, the owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) and root:content:write holders only.

get.summary: One version of a content item as the viewer sees it, with its segments and access decision.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: the language to show text in; the site's first language, then any, when it has none

patch.summary: Edits a version: languages, traits, label, state and schedule, access, attributes, text and segments. Creators, the owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) and root:content:write holders only.

delete.summary: Deletes a version; a content item keeps at least one. Creators, the owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) and root:content:write holders only.

get.summary: Content items to manage, newest first: drafts, scheduled, held and live ones; deleted ones on their own. root:content:write holders see all; others what they created, or an owner group's they edit.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: only this kind

parameters.description: items to skip

post.summary: Creates a content item as a draft. root:content:write holders, or an owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) in it.

get.summary: Lists contents as cards, one per content item with the version that fits the reader, under their visibility, site and content filters.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: only this content kind

parameters.name: groups
parameters.description: group ids every listed version is in; a position sort orders by the first

parameters.name: exclude_groups
parameters.description: group ids no listed version is in

parameters.name: owner_group
parameters.description: owner group ids (channels): only content one of them owns

parameters.name: creators
parameters.description: user ids: only content one of them is credited on

parameters.name: access
parameters.description: public (what anyone opens now), tier, group, ppv or group_ppv (what stays locked at that level): only content at one of them

parameters.name: tiers
parameters.description: configured tiers: only content locked behind one of them

parameters.name: traits
parameters.description: version traits every listed version has

parameters.name: attribute
parameters.description: name:value of one of the kind's filterable attributes; repeat for more

parameters.name: released_on
parameters.description: published on this day (YYYY-MM-DD) or month (YYYY-MM)

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: the IANA time zone of released_on and release dates; UTC by default

parameters.name: view_status
parameters.description: the signed-in reader's unseen, in_progress or completed contents

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: only content with a live version in this language

parameters.name: display_language
parameters.description: the language of titles, group names and paths, and the preferred language of each card's version; language by default

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: lock (the default: everything listed, locked cards marked) or hide (only what the reader opens)

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: newest, oldest, title, popular[:period], top_rated[:period], most_favorited, most_viewed (all time), position or random (periods: 7d, 30d, 90d, 365d, all); the kind's default, else newest

parameters.name: card_groups
parameters.description: the group kinds cards name; every kind with a page by default

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: the previous page's next_cursor

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: page size: 24 by default, at most 100

post.summary: Restores a deleted content item as it was. Creators, the owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) and root:content:write holders only.

Publishes a content item now, or schedules it for publish_at; 202 when the moderator holds it for review. Creators, the owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) and root:content:write holders only.
Returns a published or scheduled content item to a draft. Creators, the owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) and root:content:write holders only.

put.summary: Sets a content item's text in one language; 202 when the moderator holds a live item's edit (its last approved text stays public). Creators, the owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) and root:content:write holders only.

delete.summary: Removes a content item's text in one language. Creators, the owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) and root:content:write holders only.

put.summary: Replaces a content item's creators. Creators, the owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) and root:content:write holders only.

post.summary: The reference to store in a body for an inline image uploaded to the item's media folder, and a URL that shows it to the editor now. Creators, the owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) and root:content:write holders only.
Adds a version after the others. Creators, the owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) and root:content:write holders only.

put.summary: Orders a content item's versions: ids lists each version that is not deleted, first first. Creators, the owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) and root:content:write holders only.

Replaces a version's segments (chapters): ordered ranges, each released at its time. Creators, the owner group's editors (its owner, holders of {kind}:content:write in its AuthKit scope) and root:content:write holders only.

post.summary: Plans one upload after checking its path's rules and CanUpload: exists (commit directly), one PUT, or a multipart ticket.
Stages server-side copies of keys of the item's bucket outside ContentKit's namespaces, for one commit's puts (an importer's files).
Presigns multipart parts, each bound to its SHA-256.
The parts of a multipart upload that landed, to resume it.
Assembles a multipart upload; blob is its staged name.
Abandons a multipart upload.
Applies ops to an item in one conditional write, then queues placement and processing; answers its uploads as an editor reads them.

post.summary: Resolves legacy identifiers (the import's aliases) to their content's link, canonical path and locator, in order, following merges: found, not_found (unknown or hidden) or gone; at most 100.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: the language of the paths' prefix and slug

get.summary: Lists active groups with name, code, path, cover, avatar, count and a sellable group's offer and the viewer's membership, filtered, ordered and cursor-paged.

parameters.description: only groups of this kind

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: the language names, text and slugs resolve in, counts are scoped to and paths are prefixed with

parameters.description: count contents of this kind; every kind by default

parameters.name: sort

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: the previous page's next_cursor

parameters.name: limit

post.summary: Creates groups with their names and text; an auth_scope kind's gets its AuthKit scope. Staff holding root:groups:write write any group; a signed-in person creates groups of user-owned kinds, as their owner and within the kind's max_per_owner, and the owner and holders of {kind}:settings:manage in its AuthKit scope edit names, text, attributes, cover, avatar and state.

get.summary: An active group with its names, text, attributes, parent, scope, children, cover, avatar, edges, counts and sale; a merged group answers with its survivor.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: the language names, text and slugs resolve in, counts are scoped to and paths are prefixed with

patch.summary: Updates a group's given fields; state restores or deletes it. Staff holding root:groups:write write any group; a signed-in person creates groups of user-owned kinds, as their owner and within the kind's max_per_owner, and the owner and holders of {kind}:settings:manage in its AuthKit scope edit names, text, attributes, cover, avatar and state.

delete.summary: Marks a group deleted, retires its AuthKit scope and hides its media; a user-owned group's content is deleted with it, and restoring the group (PATCH state active) brings that content back, and its media within the retention. Staff holding root:groups:write write any group; a signed-in person creates groups of user-owned kinds, as their owner and within the kind's max_per_owner, and the owner and holders of {kind}:settings:manage in its AuthKit scope edit names, text, attributes, cover, avatar and state.

get.summary: The viewer's active groups: those they own, edit ({kind}:settings:manage), write content of ({kind}:content:write) or moderate comments of ({kind}:comments:moderate) through the group's AuthKit scope, or hold the key of, each saying which, as GET /groups lists them.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: only groups of this kind

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: the language names, text and slugs resolve in, counts are scoped to and paths are prefixed with

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: name (the default), count or newest

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: the previous page's next_cursor

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: page size: 50 by default, at most 200

put.summary: Replaces a group's names and aliases.

post.summary: Adds names and aliases to a group; a new canonical name demotes the old one to an alias.

delete.summary: Removes names and aliases from a group.

post.summary: Adds edges from a group.

delete.summary: Removes edges from a group.

post.summary: Merges a group into another of its kind: memberships, names, edges and children move, and its code redirects.

get.summary: A group's memberships in member order, paged.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: the previous page's next_cursor

parameters.name: limit

post.summary: Adds contents or versions to a group, or updates their position, window and state.

delete.summary: Removes contents or versions from a group.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: the language names, text and slugs resolve in, counts are scoped to and paths are prefixed with

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: the language names, text and slugs resolve in, counts are scoped to and paths are prefixed with

get.summary: The signed-in person's inbox, newest first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: page size: 20 by default, at most 100

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: the previous page's next_cursor

parameters.name: unread
parameters.description: only unread notices

parameters.name: dismissed
parameters.description: archived receipts instead of the active inbox

put.summary: Marks one of the signed-in person's notices read locally.

delete.summary: Marks one of the signed-in person's notices unread locally.

put.summary: Archives this receipt without changing its read or workflow state.

delete.summary: Restores an archived receipt to this user's inbox.

post.summary: Publishes notices in one transaction, each once per origin and recipient; a notice to an erased recipient is dropped.

get.summary: A version's reader plan: its segments with their release state, the published item of each the viewer opens, the previews of a locked version, its playback item and reader metadata. 202 while it has no current publication.

put.summary: Sets a version's reader metadata (editors): anchors and audio cues on its pages and audio uploads.

post.summary: Fills a version without media from a sibling (editors): its uploads with their outputs, reader metadata and optionally its audio and segments, in a durable job.

get.summary: A version's pages as a zip: every segment released and the version open. Charged to the viewer's download quota; marked by the host's watermark. 202 while it is prepared.

put.summary: Puts an offer on a content item: its content key opens every version. For creators of the content, editors of its owner group (its owner, holders of {kind}:offers:write or {kind}:settings:manage in its AuthKit scope) and staff holding root:offers:write.

delete.summary: Withdraws a content item's offer; buyers keep it. For creators of the content, editors of its owner group (its owner, holders of {kind}:offers:write or {kind}:settings:manage in its AuthKit scope) and staff holding root:offers:write.

put.summary: Puts an offer on one version: its version key opens it. For creators of the content, editors of its owner group (its owner, holders of {kind}:offers:write or {kind}:settings:manage in its AuthKit scope) and staff holding root:offers:write.

delete.summary: Withdraws a version's offer; buyers keep it. For creators of the content, editors of its owner group (its owner, holders of {kind}:offers:write or {kind}:settings:manage in its AuthKit scope) and staff holding root:offers:write.

put.summary: Puts an offer on a sellable group: its key opens its members and its members-only content. renew_hours makes it a subscription; amount 0 makes it free to join. Terms without renew_hours stop existing subscriptions renewing. For the group's owner, holders of {kind}:offers:write or {kind}:settings:manage in its AuthKit scope and staff holding root:offers:write.

delete.summary: Withdraws a group's offer; members keep theirs, subscribers until their paid period ends: no subscription renews. For the group's owner, holders of {kind}:offers:write or {kind}:settings:manage in its AuthKit scope and staff holding root:offers:write.

post.summary: Joins a group free to join: grants the viewer its key.

delete.summary: Leaves a group joined free; a bought membership stays.

Error.description: A refusal: a code of the operation's x-contentkit-errors or of an x-contentkit-error-sets set it names.

host.description: A credential the host's auth.Authenticator verifies (AuthKit's access tokens and API keys): ContentKit asks it who the request is.

animation_not_allowed.meaning: An animated image where the upload path refuses animation.

animation_too_long.meaning: The animation has more frames or seconds than the processor allows.

animation_unsupported.meaning: An AVIF or HEIF image sequence, which is decoded as one frame.

checksum_mismatch.meaning: The stored bytes differ from the declared SHA-256.

comment_banned.meaning: The actor is banned from commenting on this target; `ban` says the scope, the reason and when it ends.

comment_too_long.meaning: The comment is longer than the site allows; `details.max` is the limit in characters.

comments_closed.meaning: The target's comments are closed or hidden: existing ones may show, new ones and edits are refused.

comments_locked.meaning: The actor can't open the content (or the comment's version), so its comments take no writes from them; reads withhold them.

conflict.meaning: A concurrent change, a path or slug already taken, or an operation id already used for another commit.

forbidden.meaning: The actor may not do this.

image_too_large.meaning: The image has more pixels or frames than the processor decodes.

image_too_small.meaning: The edited image is narrower than its public preset's minimum width.

image_unreadable.meaning: The file is not a decodable image of its declared type.

incomplete.meaning: A multipart upload is missing parts.

internal_error.meaning: A server fault; the cause is in the server log.

invalid_request.meaning: The request is malformed: its body, a query parameter or a path value.

limit_reached.meaning: The owner already has as many groups of the kind as the site allows (max_per_owner).

moderation_rejected.meaning: The moderator refused the text; `error` says why.

not_configured.meaning: The capability needs a port the host did not configure; retrying does not help.

not_found.meaning: Nothing by that name, or nothing the actor may see.

not_joinable.meaning: The group has no free offer to join: it sells its membership, or nothing.

not_uploaded.meaning: A commit names an upload that has not landed; `blobs` lists the ones to upload again.

quota_exceeded.meaning: The uploader's storage quota is used up.

rate_limited.meaning: Too many requests; retry after `retry_after` seconds (also the Retry-After header).

tenant_mismatch.meaning: A host port answered with another tenant's data: a configuration fault.

too_large.meaning: The file is larger than its upload path allows; `details` has `size` and `max_bytes`.

too_many_files.meaning: The commit would put more files in an upload path, or the item, than allowed; `details.max` is the limit.

type_not_allowed.meaning: The file type is not allowed in the upload path; `details.allowed` lists the types.

unauthorized.meaning: The request needs a valid credential: it has none where the route needs one, or one that is expired, revoked or invalid. WWW-Authenticate says which.

unavailable.meaning: The host's auth or media storage cannot be reached, or a commit's recovery is pending; retry.

upgrade_required.meaning: The media item was stored before v0.68 and is served once the host's media upgrade (contentkit_media_upgrade) has converted it.

video_aspect_unsupported.meaning: The video's display aspect is outside what its upload path accepts; `details` has `min_aspect` and `max_aspect` (width/height).

video_over_budget.meaning: The planned encode costs more than its upload path allows, or the source averages under a frame a second.

video_too_large.meaning: The video's frames are larger than its upload path allows.

video_too_long.meaning: The video or audio runs longer than its upload path allows.
